content.title: Chapter 50 - DRAINAGE AND STORMWATER QUALITY — Sec. 50-22. - Authority.
content.summary:
The authority to establish, implement, and enforce drainage and stormwater regulations
               is derived from the city's powers and authority as a home rule city under C.R.S. tit.
               31, arts. 15 and 35 and from the Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications
               …

faqs.a:
The authority to establish, implement, and enforce drainage and stormwater regulations
               is derived from the city's powers and authority as a home rule city under C.R.S. tit.
               31, arts. 15 and 35 and from the Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications
               as adopted and amended by the city.
(
Ord. No. 4875
, § 1, 8-19-2024)
